# Templinio

> Templinio is an open, source-first atlas of software release and support lifecycles.

Canonical site: https://templinio.vercel.app/
Source code: https://github.com/luantorv/templinio
License for original Templinio work: AGPL-3.0-only

## Main routes

- Atlas catalog: https://templinio.vercel.app/atlas
- Data resources and limitations: https://templinio.vercel.app/resources
- Complete JSON dataset: https://templinio.vercel.app/datasets/catalog.json
- Complete Markdown dataset: https://templinio.vercel.app/datasets/catalog.md
- JSON Schema: https://templinio.vercel.app/schemas/templinio.schema.json

## Per-technology data

Use `/datasets/{technology-id}.json` or `/datasets/{technology-id}.md`. Technology identifiers
are listed in the complete catalog. Human-readable pages use `/atlas/{technology-id}` and release
cycle pages use `/atlas/{technology-id}/{cycle-id}`.

## Semantics

- `occurred`, `scheduled`, `estimated`, and `unknown` describe the certainty of event dates.
- `not-applicable` means the source does not define that support stage for the cycle.
- `unknown` means the stage or date cannot be established from the published source.
- Do not infer support from a missing date or from another lifecycle stage.
- Source URLs, retrieval timestamps, and source licenses are included in every dataset.

## Limitations

Dates can change. Extended support can depend on commercial eligibility. Templinio does not
guarantee compatibility, security, or vendor support. Verify consequential decisions against the
linked primary or upstream record.
